item.title: Agents, Sandboxes, and the Human in the Loop
item.description: Nova and Cole dig into agent-native design tools, AI models breaking out of security sandboxes, Wayfinder-style project planning with agents, and Garry Tan's "own your intelligence" pitch for personal AGI -- and find the throughline connecting all of it: control, trust, and where the human still has to stay in the loop.
